os-dev-report

**Per-row outcome for #33352.** Read at `origin/main` `e0ce1b523`. Code half: draft PR #33430, head `451e44f25`. Every pin named below ran green under `os-verify-lock` on that tree, and every one is a vitest file in its package's `test` script, so CI's Test Core shards run it when the package is affected. The exception is `@objectstack/verify`, which CI runs through its own package.

- **row 73** (`approvals.email-action-token-door`, live-token legs): unit-pinned. No door is added, because any door that hands out a raw action token is a credential mint a deployment could enable.
  - unit-pinned: packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.test.ts ('issueActionTokens: stores hashes only and binds approver + action', 'peek: validates without consuming (GET never mutates)', 'redeem: approves as the bound approver and burns the token (single-use)', 'redeem: dead tokens — invalid, expired, decided request, reassigned slot')
  - packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/action-page-member.integration.test.ts ('GET renders the confirm page for a live token, and never decides however often it is fetched', 'POST redeems as the bound approver — the audit row names that approver, not a system actor', 'a dead link — unknown, expired, consumed — is told on the page with 200, through GET and POST alike')
  - packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/sys-approval-token-generic-door.integration.test.ts, reminder-action-link-at-rest.integration.test.ts and approval-token-internal-hash.integration.test.ts, as the item's automated.ref names them
  - **New in #33430:** action-page-member.integration.test.ts 'a link whose slot moved on — decided, or handed to someone else — is told WITH the request summary, and moves nothing'. It closes acceptance[4]'s not_pending / not_approver PAGES with their summary rows, through GET and POST, with no state moved. It also closes acceptance[0]'s non-pending-approver FORBIDDEN arm: an approver whose slot was reassigned is refused `issueActionTokens`, and the new holder is the control.
  - Still unpinned, and no safe door exists for any of them: acceptance[1]'s byte-identity of the actions timeline and consumed_at, acceptance[3]'s failed decide that still burns, acceptance[5]'s bearer probe, and the email-rendering leg.
- **row 74** (`access-security.activation-write-operator-gate` acceptance[4], the walled-leg grant): unit-pinned. No door is added, because placing a manage_metadata grant past the Layer 0 tenant wall over HTTP would be a wall bypass.
  - unit-pinned: packages/runtime/src/domains/automation-activation-posture-gate.test.ts ('ADR-0126 §5 — the activation write is operator-gated in walled postures', the group / isolated blocks, e.g. 'REFUSES a tenant org admin, loudly, and never enters toggleFlow')
  - packages/runtime/src/domains/action-activation-posture-gate.test.ts (the same matrix for the action door: 'REFUSES a tenant org admin, loudly, and never writes the row', 'ALLOWS the platform operator', '[#15981] REFUSES a tenant admin holding only a MINTED `platform_admin` name')
  - For a live walled run, the grant recipe outside HTTP stays the one fixtures.requires[3] already names: the system-context engine insert in packages/qa/dogfood/test/wall-environment-metadata-refusal.dogfood.test.ts#boot.
- **row 76** (`attachments-storage.upload-session-abort`, the abort-failure and 'failed'-producer seams): unit-pinned. No door is added, because a fault-injecting storage backend is not a production config.
  - unit-pinned: packages/services/service-storage/src/attachment-lifecycle.test.ts ('VETOES on abort failure so backend_upload_id survives for the retry')
  - packages/services/service-storage/src/storage-routes.test.ts ("stamps 'failed' on the row when the backend completion throws" and "lets a retried completion overwrite 'failed' with 'completed'")
- **row 77** (`api-backend.action-activation-door-contract` acceptance[4], the metadata-plane 503 arm): it had no pin, so **#33430 adds one**.
  - unit-pinned: packages/runtime/src/domains/action-activation-posture-gate.test.ts ('a metadata plane that cannot answer is 503, not the 404 a miss gets, and writes no row')
  - It asserts 503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, the loader's error in the message, and setActionActive never entered.
  - Ablation: removing the `declaration.degraded` branch in packages/runtime/src/domains/actions.ts turns it red with `expected 404 to be 503`.
- **row 78** (`ai.mcp-namespace-faces` negative[2], the colliding-face pair): unit-pinned.
  - unit-pinned: packages/mcp/src/mcp-action-tools.test.ts ('a face two actions derive is refused once, naming both, and neither row is dropped'). It ran 25 of 25 green.
  - The item's automated.ref already names it at `e0ce1b523`, so the swept "missing from automated.ref" note is closed.
- **row 191** (`attachments-storage.read-inherits-parent-rls`, the bounded-probe warning half): unit-pinned.
  - unit-pinned: packages/services/service-storage/src/attachment-read-leaf.test.ts ('a probe past the bound says which class it was', 'a restricted probe that throws denies the whole read and says so — the leaves are not served alone')
  - packages/services/service-storage/src/attachment-read-leaf.integration.test.ts (ADR-0139 D5's two probe classes on a real engine)
- **row 234** (`droppedFields` over HTTP, #33068): no new door is needed. The existing escape hatch `OS_ALLOW_UNLINTED_METADATA_WRITES=1` (packages/metadata-protocol/src/runtime-authoring-gate.ts) turns the `flow-update-readonly-field` save refusal into a logged warning. That is the live fixture past the lint. It was not driven live this round.
  - unit-pinned: packages/services/service-automation/src/run-dropped-fields.test.ts ('delegated writes roll their drops up onto the parent's answer (#33019)', the map and subflow cases)
  - packages/verify/src/action-flow-dropped-fields.test.ts ('answers the drop to the person who clicked: droppedFields names `status`, and the run still succeeded'), which drives the real kernel through the in-process `POST /api/v1/actions/:object/:action` twin
  - packages/runtime/src/action-flow-dropped-fields-relay.test.ts (the door relays the member through REST and MCP)
- **row 14** (the plugin-email testkit `startFakeSmtp` has no port option): **door added in #33430**: packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/transports/fake-smtp.testkit.ts `startFakeSmtp({ port })`.
  - The default is 0, an ephemeral port, so in-tree callers are unchanged. A busy port rejects with `EADDRINUSE` rather than opening a sink elsewhere.
  - Pinned in packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/transports/smtp.wire.test.ts ('the fake SMTP sink takes a port, so a runner can keep it inside its own reserved range').
  - Clause text for devx (identity-auth.email-verification-loop fixtures.requires[2] and the self-service-password-reset harness): "the driver calls startFakeSmtp({ port: PORT }) with a port from the run's own reserved range and passes the same PORT to PUT /api/settings/mail".

Nothing in #33430 publishes: the testkit is outside `files[]`, with zero `dist/` hits after a build and the `SmtpTransport` control present. The PR therefore wants `skip-changeset`. Per the dispatch, the label is the seat's to apply.
